add_model_args: add DrQA reader model architecture and optimization CLI arguments to an argparse parser
get_model_args: filter an argparse Namespace to return only model architecture and optimizer arguments
override_model_args: merge saved model args with new args keeping architecture but overriding optimizer settings
str2bool: convert a string like yes true t 1 or y to a Python boolean
MODEL_ARCHITECTURE_MODEL_OPTIMIZER: inspect the constant sets of model architecture and optimizer argument names
